declarations.description:
A coloured dot followed by a short label, for the state of something: a deployment that is Building or Live, a
service that is Degraded, an invoice that is Overdue. The label goes in the default slot and carries the meaning, so
the colour is never the only signal; `tone` picks the colour and `pulse` adds a soft ring for a state in progress.

With an empty label the element is a bare dot. Give it an `accessible-label` then: the host becomes an image named by
that text in the accessibility tree. The same attribute on a labelled light replaces the visible text, for a short
label such as `P1` that needs a longer reading.

Size, spacing and shape are CSS variables, not attributes. Set `--c2-status-light--background`, the paddings and
the radius for a pill, `--c2-status-light__dot--clip-path` for a shape-coded dot, or put an icon in the `dot` slot;
an icon drawn with `currentColor` takes the tone colour.

Compared with `c2-indicator`, which pins a dot or count to the edge of another element, `c2-status-light` sits inline
with its own label; compared with `c2-badge`, it is text with a mark, not a filled tag.
declarations.name: StatusLight

cssProperties.description: Space between the dot and the label.
cssProperties.name: --c2-status-light--gap

cssProperties.description: Background of the whole light, for a pill. None by default.
cssProperties.name: --c2-status-light--background

cssProperties.description: Border of the whole light. None by default.
cssProperties.name: --c2-status-light--border

cssProperties.description: Corner radius, visible once a background or border is set.
cssProperties.name: --c2-status-light--border-radius

cssProperties.description: Cuts the dot to a shape, such as `polygon(50% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%)` for a triangle.
cssProperties.name: --c2-status-light__dot--clip-path

cssProperties.description: An inset shadow with a transparent background draws a ring.
cssProperties.name: --c2-status-light__dot--box-shadow

cssProperties.description: Overrides the tone colour of the dot, its pulse and a slotted icon.
cssProperties.name: --c2-status-light__dot--background

cssProperties.description: Size of an `<svg>` in the `dot` slot.
cssProperties.name: --c2-status-light__icon--size

cssProperties.description: Length of one `pulse` cycle; the ring is stilled under reduced motion.
cssProperties.name: --c2-status-light__pulse--animation-duration

cssParts.description: The coloured dot, or the wrapper of the `dot` slot.
cssParts.name: dot

cssParts.description: The wrapper of the default slot.
cssParts.name: label

slots.description: The status label, such as `Live` or `Failed`. Leave it empty for a bare dot and set `accessible-label`.
Replaces the dot with an icon or any other mark. An `<svg>` is sized by `--c2-status-light__icon--size` and coloured with the tone through `currentColor`.
slots.name: dot

members.name: pulse
members.description: Animates a fading ring around the dot, for a state in progress such as Building or an open incident.

members.name: accessibleLabel
members.description:
Text read in place of the light, which is then exposed as an image. Required for a bare dot; on a labelled light it
replaces the visible label.
